<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2107891_autofi_0.BRP: CodeAutoFixerEngine</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>BRP: CodeAutoFixerEngine</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CodeAutoFixerEngine = Class.create();
CodeAutoFixerEngine.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.companyPrefix = "BRP: ";
        this.logTable = "x_2107891_autofi_0_autofixer_log"; // Your exact table name
    },

    /**
     * Main orchestrator called by the "Auto-Fix & Prepare Code" button.
     * IMPORTANT: this only DETECTS and LOGS issues as "pending".
     * Nothing in the real Update Set is changed until a human clicks Apply.
     */
    processUpdateSet: function(updateSetId) {
        if (!updateSetId) return;

        // STEP 1: Flag background/system noise (proposed for removal, not removed yet)
        this.detectSystemJunk(updateSetId);

        // STEP 2: Flag naming and documentation issues on real script objects
        var grUpdateXML = new GlideRecord('sys_update_xml');
        grUpdateXML.addQuery('update_set', updateSetId);
        grUpdateXML.addQuery('name', 'STARTSWITH', 'sys_script')
                   .addOrCondition('name', 'STARTSWITH', 'sys_script_include')
                   .addOrCondition('name', 'STARTSWITH', 'sys_script_client'); // fixed: was "sys_client_script"
        grUpdateXML.query();

        while (grUpdateXML.next()) {
            var xmlName = grUpdateXML.getValue('name');
            var typeName = grUpdateXML.getValue('type') || "Script Component";

            // sys_update_xml.name is formatted as "<table>_<32-char sys_id>"
            if (xmlName && xmlName.length > 33) {
                var targetSysId = xmlName.substring(xmlName.length - 32);
                var targetTable = xmlName.substring(0, xmlName.length - 33);

                var grSource = new GlideRecord(targetTable);
                if (grSource.isValid() && grSource.get(targetSysId)) {
                    this.detectNamingIssue(grSource, updateSetId, typeName);
                    this.detectMissingHeader(grSource, updateSetId, typeName);
                }
            }
        }

        // STEP 3: Flag collisions with other developers' in-progress Update Sets
        this.checkConflicts(updateSetId);
    },

    /**
     * DETECT 1: Flags background/system-generated noise in the Update Set.
     * Proposed fix on Apply = remove this entry from the Update Set.
     */
    detectSystemJunk: function(updateSetId) {
        var grJunk = new GlideRecord('sys_update_xml');
        grJunk.addQuery('update_set', updateSetId);
        grJunk.addQuery('sys_created_by', 'system');
        grJunk.query();

        while (grJunk.next()) {
            var recordName = grJunk.getValue('target_name') || grJunk.getValue('name');
            var recordType = grJunk.getValue('type') || 'System Record';

            this._createLog({
                updateSet: updateSetId,
                element: recordType + ": " + recordName,
                actionType: 'junk_pending',
                details: "System-generated change detected (created by 'system'). Likely background noise (scheduled job, property auto-update) rather than real development work.",
                targetTable: 'sys_update_xml',
                targetSysId: grJunk.getUniqueValue(),
                currentValue: 'Present in update set',
                proposedValue: 'Removed from update set'
            });
        }
    },

    /**
     * DETECT 2: Flags a missing naming-convention prefix.
     * Proposed fix on Apply = rename the record.
     */
    detectNamingIssue: function(grRecord, updateSetId, tableName) {
        var currentName = grRecord.getValue('name');

        if (currentName && !currentName.startsWith(this.companyPrefix)) {
            var newName = this.companyPrefix + currentName;

            this._createLog({
                updateSet: updateSetId,
                element: tableName + ": " + currentName,
                actionType: 'naming_pending',
                previousName: currentName,
                newName: newName,
                details: "Naming convention issue: missing standard company prefix ('" + this.companyPrefix + "').",
                targetTable: grRecord.getTableName(),
                targetSysId: grRecord.getUniqueValue(),
                currentValue: currentName,
                proposedValue: newName
            });
        }
    },

    /**
     * DETECT 3: Flags a missing JSDoc header block.
     * Proposed fix on Apply = rewrite the script field with the header prepended.
     */
    detectMissingHeader: function(grRecord, updateSetId, tableName) {
        if (!grRecord.isValidField('script')) return;

        var currentScript = grRecord.getValue('script') || "";
        var recordName = grRecord.getValue('name');

        if (!currentScript.includes("/**")) {
            var today = new GlideDateTime().getLocalDate().getDisplayValue();
            var header = "/**\n" +
                         " * @name " + recordName + "\n" +
                         " * @description Automatically structured and standardized for deployment.\n" +
                         " * @date " + today + "\n" +
                         " */\n\n";
            var proposedScript = header + currentScript;

            this._createLog({
                updateSet: updateSetId,
                element: tableName + ": " + recordName,
                actionType: 'header_pending',
                previousName: recordName,
                newName: recordName,
                details: "Missing JSDoc documentation header block.",
                targetTable: grRecord.getTableName(),
                targetSysId: grRecord.getUniqueValue(),
                currentValue: currentScript,
                proposedValue: proposedScript
            });
        }
    },

    /**
     * DETECT 4: Flags collisions with other developers' in-progress Update Sets.
     * No auto-fix applies here — Apply just acknowledges/dismisses the warning.
     */
    checkConflicts: function(updateSetId) {
        var grMyUpdates = new GlideRecord('sys_update_xml');
        grMyUpdates.addQuery('update_set', updateSetId);
        grMyUpdates.query();

        while (grMyUpdates.next()) {
            var targetName = grMyUpdates.getValue('target_name');
            if (!targetName) continue;

            var grConflicts = new GlideRecord('sys_update_xml');
            grConflicts.addQuery('target_name', targetName);
            grConflicts.addQuery('update_set.state', 'In Progress');
            grConflicts.addQuery('update_set', '!=', updateSetId);
            grConflicts.query();

            while (grConflicts.next()) {
                var colleague = grConflicts.update_set.sys_created_by.getDisplayValue();
                var otherSet = grConflicts.update_set.name.getDisplayValue();

                this._createLog({
                    updateSet: updateSetId,
                    element: grMyUpdates.getValue('type') + ": " + targetName,
                    actionType: 'conflict_detected',
                    previousName: targetName,
                    newName: targetName,
                    details: "COLLISION WARNING: This element is also modified by [" + colleague + "] in the Update Set [" + otherSet + "]. Review manually before promoting.",
                    currentValue: '',
                    proposedValue: ''
                });
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * Called by the "Apply Fix" UI Action. Only acts on a record that is still 'pending'.
     */
    applyFix: function(logSysId) {
        var grLog = new GlideRecord(this.logTable);
        if (!grLog.get(logSysId)) return false;
        if (grLog.getValue('status') != 'pending') return false;

        var actionType = grLog.getValue('action_type');
        var targetTable = grLog.getValue('target_table');
        var targetSysId = grLog.getValue('target_sys_id');

        if (actionType == 'naming_pending' && targetTable && targetSysId) {
            var grName = new GlideRecord(targetTable);
            if (grName.get(targetSysId)) {
                grName.setValue('name', grLog.getValue('proposed_value'));
                grName.update();
            }
        } else if (actionType == 'header_pending' && targetTable && targetSysId) {
            var grHeader = new GlideRecord(targetTable);
            if (grHeader.get(targetSysId)) {
                grHeader.setValue('script', grLog.getValue('proposed_value'));
                grHeader.update();
            }
        } else if (actionType == 'junk_pending' && targetSysId) {
            var grXml = new GlideRecord('sys_update_xml');
            if (grXml.get(targetSysId)) {
                grXml.deleteRecord();
            }
        }
        // conflict_detected: nothing to apply — Apply just acknowledges it below

        grLog.setValue('status', 'applied');
        grLog.update();
        return true;
    },

    /**
     * Called by the "Reject" UI Action. Marks the log as rejected, no change made.
     */
    rejectFix: function(logSysId) {
        var grLog = new GlideRecord(this.logTable);
        if (grLog.get(logSysId)) {
            grLog.setValue('status', 'rejected');
            grLog.update();
        }
        return true;
    },

    /**
     * Central log writer — every detection method funnels through here.
     */
    _createLog: function(logData) {
        var grLog = new GlideRecord(this.logTable);
        grLog.initialize();
        grLog.setValue('update_set', logData.updateSet);
        grLog.setValue('corrected_element', logData.element);
        grLog.setValue('action_type', logData.actionType);
        grLog.setValue('previous_name', logData.previousName || '');
        grLog.setValue('new_name', logData.newName || '');
        grLog.setValue('details', logData.details);
        grLog.setValue('target_table', logData.targetTable || '');
        grLog.setValue('target_sys_id', logData.targetSysId || '');
        grLog.setValue('current_value', logData.currentValue || '');
        grLog.setValue('proposed_value', logData.proposedValue || '');
        grLog.setValue('status', 'pending');
        grLog.insert();
    },

    type: 'CodeAutoFixerEngine'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-15 09:57:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>7c651ede73ca4f104f31ff604ab8b713</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>BRP: CodeAutoFixerEngine</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AutoFixer : Code Governance " source="x_2107891_autofi_0">f8f593d0738e03104f31ff604ab8b7f0</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="AutoFixer : Code Governance ">f8f593d0738e03104f31ff604ab8b7f0</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_7c651ede73ca4f104f31ff604ab8b713</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-19 17:38:51</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
